cves.reason: the decoder's error table has DISTANCE (Brotli 1.0.3 and later) but not BLOCK_SWITCH, the error code the fix added

findings.fix: Update the system Brotli package (libbrotli1, brotli-libs, libbrotli or brotli) to your vendor's fixed build, or build Brotli 1.0.10, 1.1.1 or 1.2.1, then restart the programs that load it.
